unit_system: natural-HEP: GeV for energies, s in GeV^2; cross sections quoted in pb (1 nb = 1000 pb)
renormalization_scheme: not-applicable at tree level; alpha is a fixed input (its value enters only through the reference constant below)
scales: not-applicable at tree level with fixed alpha: no renormalization or factorization scale enters and alpha is not run to sqrt(s), so there is no scale variation or scale uncertainty
angle_definition: theta between the incoming e- and the outgoing mu- in the c.m. frame
spin_treatment: unpolarized beams: average over the four initial spin states, sum over final spins
mass_approximation: electrons massless; muon mass kept in the derivation, massless (beta -> 1) in the numerical prediction
qedbench:reference_constant: 4 pi alpha^2 / 3 converted to nb GeV^2 is taken as 86.8 nb GeV^2 from PDG eq. (51.3) [qedbench:C02], three significant figures
